_readme: Author decisions that override conflicting or missing values in the thesis text. status: decided = author answered; derived = follows directly from the thesis's own tables, author confirmation pending; open = no answer yet (the app must show it as 'open', never guess). 'thesisFix' says what must change in the thesis text itself.

studyPlan.goal: Deep understanding of the whole thesis by the end date
studyPlan.note: Author gave a study window, not a defense date. Scheduler counts back from the window end (2026-10-10) until a defense date is entered.

decisions.topic: PatchTST patch length and stride actually run
decisions.basis: Author's code: benchmarks/compare_three_models_ett.py:85-86, compare_four_models_london.py:122-123, compare_four_models_steel.py:122-123; code default 16/8 (models/patchtst.py:180). All runs use seq_len=96, pred_len=24, label_len=48.
decisions.thesisFix: 4.2.1 uses P16/S4 as an illustration only; label it as such. State the STEEL 12/6 override (15 patches). WTH setting not provided.

decisions.topic: 68,000 s Autoformer training time and PatchTST MSE 18.38 (Section 3.4.1)
decisions.basis: Author searched the repo (.py .md .json .csv .txt); neither value exists in any saved run. Longest runs: London Autoformer 10,695 s, Informer 11,119 s; best London MSE 20.19.
decisions.thesisFix: Delete both numbers from 3.4.1 unless a log outside the repo exists. Never taught in the app.

decisions.basis: Run three_models_comparison_ett_20260903_180948 (matches Table 4.2). The 13.6/25.9/13.8 figures in the thesis are gains over the mean of the other two models (recomputed and confirmed), not over Informer alone. Run three_models_comparison_20260903_165839 is the WTH run (its Informer MSE 0.4046 and PatchTST MSE 0.4871 are Table 4.1), not an ETT run.
decisions.thesisFix: 4.4.2 and 5.1 say 'over Informer' for 13.6/25.9/13.8. Either state the baseline (mean of Informer and Autoformer) or use 15.7/33.8/18.6 for Informer. Cite run 180948. Do not mix the sets.

decisions.topic: 'Informer is the fastest Transformer on every dataset'
decisions.value: True on WTH (1,100.9 s) and ETTh1 (525.6 s) only. On STEEL (PatchTST 173.7 s vs Informer 502.0 s, which diverged) and Smart Meters (PatchTST 3,905.5 s vs Informer 11,119.1 s) PatchTST is faster.
decisions.thesisFix: Restrict the claim to WTH and ETTh1, in the abstract and 4.4.2, 4.6.1, 4.6.3.

decisions.basis: No code calls torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated or any memory logger. Repo docs list a Tesla V100 32 GB and per-model GB figures (Informer 6.2-7.8, PatchTST 3.8-4.9) and '80-90% / 4-8 GB' claims; none is backed by code or saved output, and the machine is an RTX 2060 Max-Q with 6 GB.
decisions.thesisFix: Remove the claim that peak VRAM was recorded, or measure it and report peak allocated memory. The only VRAM figure the app teaches is the 6GB budget.

decisions.topic: What the London Smart Meters data actually is

value.granularity: daily, one row per household (LCLid) per day; energy statistics (median, mean, max, std, min, sum) pre-aggregated from half-hourly readings
value.split: by household, np.random.seed(42): 100 test households, then 20% of the remaining households for validation; households with fewer than 365 days dropped
value.windowing: households stacked into one long table; SlidingWindowDataset (utils/data_loader.py:62) has no per-household boundary, so some 96-day windows span two households

decisions.thesisFix: Describe as 'daily, per-household records, split by household, concatenated for windowing'. Not aggregated across households. 3.2.4 and 4.1 say half-hourly; 3.3 says a chronological 70/20/10 split across all datasets. Add the window-crossing issue to the limitations.

value.seeds: none set (only the London household split uses seed 42)
value.steelInformerAutoformer: diverged: NaN metrics and infinite validation loss; report as failed, not as results
value.mape: London MAPE infinite for every model; not tabulated

decisions.basis: Author's results folders; docs/EXPERIMENTAL_RESULTS_AND_DISCUSSION.md:1804 says 'Single Run... No multiple random seeds'. The same file's '54 experiments (3 datasets x 6 models x 3 runs)' and '~380 GPU hours' (line 2163) are unsupported and are not used.
decisions.thesisFix: Add a caveat that each figure is a single run, so small gaps (e.g. Informer vs Autoformer on ETTh1) may fall within seed variance. Disclose the Autoformer ETTh1 early stop at epoch 9.
